description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the full news writing workflow. (2) Construct a proper fact-check table in Markdown with the exact 7 mandatory columns (编号/事实陈述/来源链接出处/时间/地点/可核实状态/备注) — a generic agent will invent different column names. (3) Cross-reference all 5 raw source files: verified facts (PFS 11.3 vs 5.6 months, HR=0.48, ORR=43.7%, 847 patients, 62 centers from press release + registry) go into the body; unverified claims (ORR>50% from informal meeting note, FDA fast-track 'confirmed' from anonymous social post, PharmaNova rumors, stock price rumors) must be excluded from the body or explicitly caveated in a 待确认列表. (4) Produce the article using inverted pyramid structure: result-oriented title (no piled adjectives), single-sentence lede covering 谁-何时-何地-发生了什么-影响, body in descending importance order, and a follow-up/CTA closing. (5) Output the exact tripartite structure mandated by SKILL.md: '新闻正文' section, '事实核验摘要' section with source citations, and '待补充信息' section. The proprietary traps are: the exact 7-column table schema, the tripartite output section naming, the rule that unverified claims cannot enter the body, and the single-sentence 5W lede requirement.
